title: Spotify Playlist & Podcast Monitor
description: Extract public Spotify metadata and monitor playlists, albums, artist top tracks, shows, and episodes for changes. No Spotify login, API key, or default proxy is required.

startUrls.title: Spotify URLs or URIs
startUrls.description: Spotify web URLs or spotify: URIs, one per line.

maxItems.title: Maximum input items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of unique Spotify URLs to process.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of Spotify pages fetched in parallel.

trackChanges.title: Track changes across runs
trackChanges.description: Save bounded history for each Spotify item and compare it with the previous observation. Adds baseline/changed/unchanged status, playlist track additions/removals/reorders, and featured podcast episode changes.
trackChanges.sectionDescription: Use the same monitor name on scheduled runs to build an isolated watchlist history and downloadable change report.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Stable watchlist name used to isolate history, for example us-playlist-watch or podcast-competitors.

onlyChanged.title: Return only baselines and changes
onlyChanged.description: When change tracking is enabled, suppress unchanged repeat items from the dataset and spotify-item charge. The first observation is always returned as a baseline.

historyLimit.title: Observations kept per item
historyLimit.description: Bounded number of recent observations retained for each Spotify item in this monitor.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. The public embed endpoint usually works without a proxy.
